as_of_after.body: This article covers webhook timeout in Cobalt Gateway. A webhook call is cancelled after 30 seconds, so reply with a 200 status first and do slow work later. Check the delivery log in the dashboard, then follow the steps in the settings page for webhook timeout.

as_of_before.body: This article covers webhook timeout in Cobalt Gateway. Customers often write that the webhook returns a 504 timeout for every event. Check the account status first, then follow the steps in the settings page for webhook timeout.
